name: Scrap Mite
description: A tiny squat round rust-red sorting crawler, six short stout iron legs, one orange sensor aperture and two little scrap sorting mandibles. Round beetle silhouette, patched plate.

name: Rivet Hound
description: A low lean industrial quadruped seam-inspection machine, four stout piston legs, wedge-shaped rust iron head pointing down-right, front rivet jaws and long compressed spring spine. No organic parts. Angular charging silhouette.

name: Choir Drone
description: A hovering corrupted acoustic factory signal machine. Three large dark speaker mouths in a compact triangular rust iron housing, brass suspension yoke and small red signal lens. No wings, no legs, no effects. Bell-like hanging silhouette.

name: Scrap
description: A single compact cluster of three chunky salvaged objects: worn brass hex nut, bent iron bracket, copper wire loop. Readable currency pickup, not coins, no gold pile.

name: Relic Shard
description: One large broken cream ceramic machine-reliquary fragment with a brass repaired seam, small inset green enamel patch and exposed copper edge. Asymmetric angular shard, not crystal or gem.

name: Field Repair Kit
description: One chunky old green enamel maintenance tin, cream lid with simple pale mint wrench emblem, brass latch, stubby side handle, one soldered patch. No text, no medical cross.

name: Saint's Rivet
description: One oversized short brass rivet with broad worn domed head, cream ceramic collar and tiny green thread tied beneath it. Humble treasured fastener, diagonal three-quarter view.

name: Spare Hand
description: One detached friendly three-fingered mechanical maintenance hand with cream ceramic finger plates, green enamel palm and brass articulated joints, short capped wrist. Open helpful palm, no arm.

name: Inspection Lens
description: One chunky round inspection loupe with large pale cyan glass lens, worn brass concentric rim, green enamel short folding handle and visible soldered hinge repair. Crisp simple silhouette.
